body:
The separate Worker01 review has completed all nine coordinator scope candidates, including the exact Oxoid and BD-Difco candidates. Its primary scientist, technical reviewer and independent skeptic authored none of those candidates. The coordinator rehashed all 123 sealed review files and all nine candidate bytes.

For NEW-OXOID-CM0149, SHA256 `1ec7554da19d5a6ab2259ee79d178a95511a923e611f4fc176af498248ab76ae`, the bounded named-product correction is supported, with no exact finding against this payload. NBRC902 explicitly identifies the catalogue product; the candidate does not invent a prior owner or attach a modern quantitative formula to an unknown historical lot. Its authentic coordinator creation/history and corrected evidence typing remain intact. The separate BD-Difco promotion SHA256 `acf0d66eb53dc60379c8819153f7fe869992fb36d7f957c7269a8d7f7e1eaefe` preserves MediaDive1769 continuity and the source-qualified approximate nine-part formula, without using Oxoid observations as Difco membership.

This supplies the completed scientific-review prerequisite for W03’s bounded report-only origin successor described in comment6718725418. W03 must still verify the exact candidate, source case, retirement/backlinks, unchanged other cases and independent final successor review before ordinary publication. This does not grant maintained-owner, generic RCM, role or export approval. Historical version, catalogue-package and broader owner-membership limitations remain. Any changed candidate bytes require an explicit new review.

The nine-candidate review retains one existing #1226 provenance defect on a different Soy_Peptone candidate. It does not report that defect against this Oxoid payload. Handoff SHA256 `1c320b85dc7ff0f35e5015968e9f290179bc4226b349225ea3b4b4c6f82e6c49`; review manifest `6da888b709d8d304a072af5c74af3323de8caae9c7bac829d87dd96ef3e7ebdd`; author manifest `6c89863e292bf1b4333be602bf4a355c0219766456d16e1f574bb5412d956df9`. Unqualified whole-candidate acceptance remains withheld; the stated product-specific scientific correction is supported.
